newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE TO SIGN ECONOMIC AGREEMENTS WITH LEBANON.
newsitem.headline: GREECE TO SIGN ECONOMIC AGREEMENTS WITH LEBANON.

text.p: Greece and Lebanon will sign agreements on economic and technological cooperation and the mutual protection and promotion of investments on Thursday, a national economy ministry official told Reuters.
The agreements will be signed by Greek National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou and his Lebanese counterpart, she said.
Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik Hariri is on an official two-day visit to Athens and is due to meet Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis today. --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
